title: We made a 15-minute film-set mystery where you win arguments by cutting footage into people's lies
author: SuruiMakesGames
selftext:
Scene 47, take 2. The prop gun goes off, and the leading man never gets up. The actress swears she didn't pull the trigger—and nobody believes her.

We just released a short noir detective game where you play as the director, and the only thing you have to prove what really happened is the raw footage.

You’ll scrub through takes frame by frame (zooming in and pushing the exposure to catch what the camera saw), walk the crime scene to grill a cast still standing on their marks, and confront their lies by cutting your evidence straight into their testimony.

It’s a free \~15-minute mystery on Windows, made in Unreal Engine for the Epic AI MegaJam.

Play it here:[https://suruimakesgame.itch.io/in-the-mood-for-cut](https://suruimakesgame.itch.io/in-the-mood-for-cut)

Some parts of the game is not perfect because of the limited time. Would genuinely love to know if any of the clues tripped you up or where you got stuck!
